newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Nov 8.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Friday:
- European intelligence agencies have discovered that the Bosnian government has been smuggling arms into the country.
- The White House has criticised the Pentagon investigation into whether U.S. soldiers were exposed to Iraqi chemical weapons during the Persian Gulf War.
- U.S. scientists sent a spacecraft to Mars to try to find out whether life existed or still exists on the planet.
- U.S. President Bill Clinton said his cabinet selections for his second term in office would reflect a move to the "vital centre," hinting at the possibility of inviting an opposition member.
- Former Republican Party presidential candidate Bob Dole led one of the most ineffectual campaigns in the country's recent political history.
- The U.S. liquor industry has decided to end its voluntary ban on the advertising liquor products on radio and television.
- Eastman Kodak is having trouble establishing itself in South Africa again after having abandoned the market during apartheid.
